title: Nutty Savory Irish Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring pork, Sichuan pepper, and lardons, made diabetic-friendly with careful ingredient selection. This dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the pot and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the pork cubes to the pot and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground Sichuan pepper, thyme, carrots, and potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the pot, covering the ingredients and bringing to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven, cooking for 2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the rendered lardons.
Season the stew to taste and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
